description: Nonexecuting, review-first verification checklist grounded in Buddy-Walk/buddy-walk package scripts on main. No app behavior has been verified.
prerequisites: Use a disposable checkout of Buddy-Walk/buddy-walk; inspect the current scripts before running
Install dependencies for mobile/ and team-console/ using their documented package managers; confirm lockfiles
Do not use production credentials or real user data; do not run a live API or device workflow without an approved test environment
Review command side effects and required permissions with a maintainer

checks.expected: Observe exit status and full output from mobile TypeScript check and mobile test runner; inspect any skipped tests
checks.risk: Local test scripts can execute arbitrary repository code; no runtime/device behavior is established

checks.expected: Observe build exit status and output; confirms build only, not deployed behavior
checks.risk: Local build scripts and plugins execute code; may require environment configuration
